title: Zoo Problems
blurb: You are a giraffe. Sneak around the zoo and cause as much trouble as you can without getting caught.

title: Limited Gravity
blurb: You are an alien. Explore space, fight humans, talk to other aliens, and open the giant chest at the end of every mission.

title: Koala Nightmares
blurb: Pack your bag, camp in the jungle, study the animals. Then it gets dark, and something is up in the trees.

title: Salon Teckel
blurb: You are a German Shepherd who grooms dachshunds. You do not get to choose your tools. Some of them are bees.
